scope: Three complete scalp-style method questions on two fixed reused native months, not a claim about every instrument or independent economic skill.

windows.selection: Exactly the two clean full months fixed before market outcomes. March, January and February refusals remain data history, not negative strategy results. No further month fallback.
windows.quotes: Both months lack observed BID/ASK; unchanged modeled costs only. Provider BID candle volume is not exchange order flow.

method_questions.bb: Does the retained population-band/closed-SMA20 exit bundle behave better than sample-band/native ATR control in these two other full months? This is not a full reproduction of author Methods I-IV.
method_questions.ema: For identical registered closed EMA20/50 pretrend pullback entry/confidence, compare native ATR protection with the actual three-closed-setup-bar extreme plus one execution point and nominal 2R target from actual fill.
method_questions.retest: Compare original rolling-level/ATR method with a frozen prior-20-bar breakout level, later closed directional rejection within three contiguous bars, level-relative confidence and structural protection plus nominal 2R. This is one bundled method contrast, not individual component credit.

common_contract.geometry: Stop is buffered one execution point beyond the actual source invalidation, not a clamped ATR fallback. Next-open fill determines nominal price-distance 2R. Stop-fill costs/commission determine position size under the unchanged risk/leverage ceiling; net reward/risk is not 2R.
common_contract.unknown_geometry: Missing, future, nonadjacent, crossed or wrong-direction setup is an entry veto and no structural shadow fallback.
common_contract.confidence: The new retest topology measures existing clipped distance/ATR confidence against its own frozen level, with the same ADX strength transform and threshold; missing level is WAIT. Old rolling-level control is unchanged.
common_contract.scope_limitations: Single M5 candle clock, modeled costs and conservative native gap/intrabar handling. A six-observed-row cap is not a universal session-flat or broker-fill guarantee.

execution.on_timeout: Retain technical unknown. No automatic cap extension, restart, retry or replacement after outcomes.

assessment.primary: Matched complete-account realized cash delta per method and month. Also retain absolute cash, mature trades, closed-cash drawdown, holding, opportunity/context and EOF exposure. Relative improvement while losing money is not useful economic skill.
research_agent_practice_prerequisites_ea: Both original accounts completed and comparable
Treatment net cash positive and above its own control
Each control and treatment has at least 20 mature trades; diagnostic sample prerequisite, not statistical power
Both accounts have no EOF-open position
Treatment closed-cash drawdown no greater than control
No holding beyond declared scalp cap
assessment.if_eligible: Select the first eligible method in fixed priority, not maximum PnL. Prepare a separately sealed provisional agent-practice question through existing owners; do not import curator products as agent-owned experience.
assessment.if_none: Retain measured negative/unknown/context know-how. No automatic agent handoff or fake useful skill. Record the next discriminating question rather than force a positive result.
assessment.multiple_testing: All three families, controls and both months are retained. No after-outcome settings, best-month filter or unchanged-data independence claim.

policy: All 2026 and later market data remain paper-only. These 2025 reused archives do not create an untouched window. No broker demo, production release, population or public order is created.
